text:
Perfect! I've successfully authenticated your identity. Now I can help you with your exchange. 

You mentioned you have an order number and need to exchange some items. Could you please provide me with your order number so I can look up the details?
zh:
太好了！我已成功验证您的身份。现在我可以帮您处理换货了。 

您提到您有订单编号，需要换一些东西。您能提供一下您的订单编号，让我查一下详情吗？
